label: PF Backlog 421
title: EPIC A: PF Commercial & IP Foundation (contracts, Go core, licensing, packaging, EAP, RDC, governance, vertical slice)
body: Needed-now foundation for a commercially deployable, IP-protected PF platform. One source -> many editions; new features -> Go; existing Python -> compiled; no raw .py shipped. See docs/PF-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE-AND-IP-PLAN.md.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/licensing.py, core/packaging.py, core/skill_contracts.py, /api/v1/packaging/build

context_review.reason: Epic-level body lacks specific acceptance criteria for sub-deliverables; needs decomposition and doc confirmation.

brief.problem: PF must become a commercially deployable, IP-protected platform shipped as editions from one source: new shipped/sensitive logic in Go, existing Python compiled, no raw .py shipped. See docs/PF-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE-AND-IP-PLAN.md.
brief.what_adds: EPIC A — the needed-now foundation: A0 baseline freeze + ADR register; A1 thin contracts incl. Go<->Python contract; A2 capability registry + entitlement-at-boundary + asymmetric licensing; A3 build->package->deploy + compiled packaging (Nuitka + go build) + signing + SBOM/LBOM + no-raw-.py gate; A4 EAP delivery manifest + compatibility; A5 Runtime Dependency Compiler; A6 governance (change classifier, language rule, no-undeclared-dep); A7 vertical slice.
brief.why: Protect IP and ship multiple editions from one source, gating normal feature work until the A7 vertical slice proves the path.
brief.who_feels: PF platform maintainers, workers, and customers.
